create_deep_cfr_solver: create a DeepCFRSolver instance with configurable policy and advantage network layers for solving imperfect information games
run_deep_cfr_solve: run the DeepCFRSolver.solve() method to train the solver and return advantage losses and policy loss
build_tabular_policy: build a tabular policy from a callable action probabilities function using policy.tabular_policy_from_callable
test_nash_conv: test the solver quality by computing NashConv with exploitability.nash_conv on the average policy
summarize_policy_values: summarize expected game scores for each player using expected_game_score.policy_value on the average policy
